_doc: Manual decisions for tools/translations_match.py. Keys are app ids from hisn_elmoslem.db. contents: zikrs = the source DB ZekarIDs whose translation is used (empty = no translation), coverage = exact|near|combined|partial. titles: category = the source DB CategoryID, names = per-language name used instead of the category name.

29.note: the source DB category 27 is named for morning and evening (En 'Remembrance said in the morning and evening', Fr 'Du matin et du soir'); the app splits the chapter, so the name is cut to the morning part. Owner to confirm the wording.

30.note: the source DB category 135 (evening) has no English or French name; the name follows the morning one. Owner to confirm the wording.

92.note: Preface before Ayat al-Kursi. the source DB En 74 at the same id is a glossary note about morning/evening times, not this text, and Fr has no item.

148.note: App gives the text of Surat As-Sajda; the source DB 110 only says the Prophet recited As-Sajda and Al-Mulk before sleeping (an instruction, not a meaning of the verses).

332.note: App gives the text of Surat Al-Mulk; same reason as 148.

184.note: App gives the full adhan; the source DB 147 is only the instruction 'The athan (call to prayer)'.

272.note: Barking dogs / braying donkeys: the source DB 234 (category 112) is the same hadith; Arabic adds 'al-Azim'. binwahaf links this content to the wrong lesson, so the number route cannot confirm.

287.note: App 'Allahumma barik fima a'tayt'; the source DB 249 is a different wording ('Allahumma barik alayh') plus a definition of the evil eye. Excluded rather than shown as a meaning of other words.
